description: Prior low-dose Bactrim tolerance was 8 years ago instead of 10 years ago
presentation: A 50-year-old man with IgA nephropathy, diabetes insipidus, and recurrent UTIs presents with suspected drug allergy after Bactrim for UTI: pruritus and hives on arms/trunk began after the 4th dose; patient self-discontinued after the following dose. He also noted dark urine, and labs showed AKI (Cr 2.5 from baseline 1.2) that resolved over the next month. He previously tolerated once-daily low-dose Bactrim for 6 months 8 years ago. Does the patient need sulfa allergy testing? Is the AKI was part of an allergic reaction or a separate adverse effect?
